title: Chapter 887
paragraphs: Chapter 887
Episode 221. Unexpected Developments (3)
Back to Kikaro Plain.
As soon as Tilius and Misol ended the communication, they spread their arms wide towards Luna.
“… Surely you're not suggesting a hug to commemorate our alliance? Ah, of course, our lord still doesn’t fully recognize you as allies.”
“No, that's not it. Now, injure Misol and I. If we return unscathed, Sakiell will doubt us even more.”
“Do we really have to do that? Can't we just say we saw the two of you die and then ran away?”
“Would you believe that if you were in their shoes?”
“If my colleagues said so, I would believe the
“To Jito, Paelleito, and Sakiell, we're not colleagues, but subordinates. Moreover, I'm from Bisects, so I'm naturally suspicious. It would be better in many ways to return looking severely injured.”
Luna expressed her deep reluctance. Even though Jin didn’t fully accept the alliance, if what Tilius and Misol said was true,

They were characters close to being righteous. Moreover, they were pitiful, as their families were held hostage, they had to play the role of spies, and sometimes they had to kill their colleagues with their own hands. She couldn't feel comfortable hurting them.
“Don’t worry, we're used to the pain. Hurry up, we don’t have much time.”
“Ugh, how badly should I injure you?”
“Make it look like we’re near death.”
“Sigh, can't be helped then.”
Slash-!

Crentel inflicted various injuries on them for a while. Purple blood and flesh splattered. Sometimes, Luna deliberately mixed a little red energy into her attack, because now it was important to make it obvious.
Tilius and Misol didn't scream once even as their bodies were torn and shattered.
“I guess this is enough. Damn, it feels so uncomfortable.”
“Perfect. If I knew you'd feel this uncomfortable, I would've gotten injured during the fight earlier.”

“Right, in Jinma-Gye, there's a rumor that Baekgyeong Luna is a heartless demon who doesn't shed blood or tears. You've annihilated many warlords and demon kings already. Turns out you're kinder than I thought.”
“Any rumors about our lord?”

“None yet, but the video of the power of Manbing annihilating warlords has spread among the demon kings. It's best to always be careful. Manbing is also a special management target like the Red Energy.”
Due to the unrecovered injuries, the two staggered for a while, then they pulled out one last piece of Jito's flesh.
“We'll say that we used the flesh as our last resort to escape.”
“When can we meet again?”
"Perhaps in not too distant a future. I'll try to set up a way to communicate regularly somewhere in the mortal realm. I must be going now."
"Go, with our best wishes."
"Let's meet again, Lord of the White Palace. I'm sorry I couldn't explain more, there must be a lot you're curious about."
When Tylias shattered the piece of flesh, a purple dimension door suddenly opened. Luna and Sirius shrugged their shoulders, watching the two disappear into the portal.
"Let's return to Tikkan as well, my Lord."
[Rumble!]

"……With Tylias gone, the portal to the parallel universe is opening. Ability disruption, if it's an enemy, it is the most troublesome kind. According to what the dead Kukan said, Tylias can even block the abilities coming from the flesh of Zito."
"Anyways, while only insane beings seemed to be appearing starting from the enemy race, for the first time, characters with potential to be allies appeared."
When Morte ran through the parallel universe, the scenery of the Tikkan Palace appeared instantly.
"You're back, my lord."
"Yes, how does it feel?"
"It doesn't feel like a lie. But we'll have to keep an eye on them for now."
"They said they're going to establish a network of Bishops in the mortal realm soon. If they continue to provide useful information like this time, I think we can trust them a bit."
"I think so too. But I'm worried about the part about the red energy......"
"I was going to talk about that. In this battle, I felt like the red energy was going to run wild."
"Run wild?"
"Yes. But, it didn’t make me feel tired at all. That was strange."
"You might want to refrain from using the red energy for a while, just in case."
"Probably. But if I start conserving the red energy right after today, Tylias and Misol might be in trouble. Above all, I trust my father's opinion more than the demons."
Unlike Tylias and Misol, Syron never mentioned the 'side effects' of red energy. He simply suggested to conserve it as much as possible.

"If the depletion of red energy was as dangerous as the demons said, wouldn't my father have properly warned me? Despite the feeling that the red energy was going to run wild this time, I didn’t sense any danger."
"I've never handled the red energy, so it's hard to say. But perhaps your father knew it was dangerous but deliberately did not warn you."
Although he has recently regained his humanity after breaking free from the devil's charm, Syron was never a kind and tender father to begin with.
He might have known that red energy was dangerous, but he might have been picturing Luna overcoming it on his own and progressing to the next stage, according to Jin's thought.

"Ah… that might be the case. He's definitely the kind to do that. Then it's even more correct to follow my father's will, isn't it? After all, the red energy is a crossroads that one must pass to move further ahead."
That was also a valid point.
"Hmm, I will fully trust your judgement regarding the use of red energy. However, please stop immediately if you feel it's not right."
"Don't worry, my youngest. The prince and I need to rest for about a day and prepare for the next battle. The prince has abilities like red energy in his possession, so we can look forward to it."
The Demon Realm, Sea Base.
Tillias and Misol were report to Sakiel with serious faces.
"So, the true gears from Earth, provided by Reila, were all used, and Baekgyeong significantly depleted his red energy. Is that all?"
"Yes, that's right. In fact, during the battle, I wanted to save at least one of the flesh pieces as I was stuck, but in order for Misol and me to escape...."
"You did well. Losing both of you would be a significant loss, considering the number of Demon Lords and Warlords has been decreasing rapidly."
Tillias bowed his head.

"Everything is going worse than Earth expected. Because of Ayulra, the time when Earth could appear on the human world has been delayed, and the resistance from the human world is intense. And somehow, the Biseuks seem to be well aware of this."
"Mi, Misol?"
Sakiel's eyes narrowed.
"Did you know that as soon as we started investing in the human world, the attacks from the Biseuks increased?"
"I recently had a banquet with the Demon Lords at Lagal Pun's castle, but I did not hear about it."

"Were you with Reila and Dailelus? The day of that event, both of their castles were attacked. Basset appeared directly in Reila's castle, and Tuale came to Dailelus's castle. Ten warlords were killed. More than 200,000 of the demons in the city were also kidnapped."
Biseuks have been kidnapping demons every time they attack.
They believed that this was a way to prevent ordinary demons from falling into Earth's plaything.

"Until now, it was about 10,000 or 20,000 at most. But suddenly, kidnapping 200,000 suggests that Basset's abilities have increased for some reason. They could have absorbed the power of the kidnapped demons... or, the power of the immortal region, which had been weakened, could have recovered. The name 'immortal' wasn't attached to the Biseuks-controlled land for no reason."
Tillias easily grasped Sakiel's intention.
'......He wants to confirm whether I, also a Biseuk, have restored the power of the Immortal Region.'
Indeed, Tillias had recovered a significant amount of power from the Immortal Region. That's why he was able to block the energy from Earth's flesh in this battle.

"The fact that my power has increased is true. However, if it's in the numbers you mentioned, Basset's power has become ten times stronger than before. It's on a level that can't be compared to mine. So in my opinion, Basset didn't become stronger, but... he must have been hiding his power."
"Hiding his power...."
Sakiel nodded and smiled at the words.
"At times like these, I wish Lord Tilius had more hidden power to rely on. Both of you should recuperate and prepare to face Baijing again."
"Misol!?"
Misol made a scared face and rolled her eyes.
"So far, you two are the only Demon Kings who have returned alive from facing Baijing. So, there should be more opportunities."
If they encounter Baijing and come back alive once more, he wouldn't doubt them anymore.
That's what Sakiel was saying. To live under suspicion or to die proving innocence. It was clearly the worst-case scenario that Tilius had predicted.
'Next time, I will surely die at Baijing's hands... If I come back alive again, Sakiel will undoubtedly request Zito to torture me.'

Tilius had already endured Zito's torture once. But she didn't have the confidence to endure it again. This time she would likely confess everything about Bisek during the torture, so it would be much better to tell Luna the situation and disappear.
"I understand. Next time, I will surely exhaust Baijing's red power."
"Yes, I'm looking forward to it. You can go now. Oh, wait... Lord Zito!"
Bubble, bubble...
Suddenly, Sakiel's crystal ball seemed to boil and Zito's face appeared.
{[Hey, Sakiel. Are you crazy?]}
"Lord Zito?"
{[Why are you doubting Tilius again and fussing? Have you forgotten that she already had a deep conversation with me?]}
"I'm sorry."
{[Let Tilius and Misol rest a bit, and send other guys for the job of catching Baijing. Got it?]}
It was a godsend.
Tilius thought so, feeling relief inside. If she and Misol disappeared now, the relationship with the newly forming Barmel Alliance could become ambiguous.
"I will do that."
{[Good, keep providing flesh. Tell the Demon Kings and Generals to properly handle Baijing. Stand up to the challenge.]}
As Zito's energy faded in the crystal ball, Sakiel wiped off her cold sweat.
"...I'm sorry for doubting you, Tilius. You may leave."
"Not at all, Lord Sakiel. If you need anything else, feel free to call."
"Misol, Misol."
And then, Zito shivered in the demon world, grinning.
{Ah, our adorable ones, watching you makes me just want to bite and kill you. Isn't that right? Helluram.}
